title: What is serverless GPU computing?
summary: Discover serverless GPUs and their benefits. Learn the basics, business advantages, and how to start for faster, cost-efficient development.
body_markdown: Lately, serverless GPUs have been gaining a lot of traction among machine learning engineers. In this blog, we'll dive into what serverless computing is all about and trace the journey that brought us here. We'll also explore the benefits of serverless GPUs and how they can speed up the time to market for your ML projects. Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting out, this guide will help you understand why serverless GPUs are becoming a game-changer in the tech world.
